title.narrative: Greater Mekong Subregion: Cambodia Northwest Provincial Road Improvement Project

description.narrative: The proejct will assist the Government of Cambodia to improve the provincial national road network in northwestern Cambodia and the cross-border facility with Thailand. The proeject includes (i) improvement of National Road 56 (NR 56) (from Sisophon to Samraong, approximately 113 kilometers, (ii) improvement of the cross-border facility at O'smach, (iii) a road maintenance program, (iv) a road safety program, and (iv) an HIV prevention and anti-human trafficking program.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Increased transport efficiency in northwestern Cambodia

Average travel time to services in the project districts of 1.0-1.5 hours in 2010 are reduced to 30-45 minusted by 2018 Progress/Status: The project has been fully completed but the KEXIM-financed section of NR 56B is currently at a progress of 82%. This is likely to be achieved by project completion. Data Source: ADB field traffic surveys MPWT annual reports Base year: 2009

Increased average trip lengths of the project road by 40% from 2010 in 2013 Progress/Status: The project has been fully completed but the KEXIM-financed section of NR 56B is currently at a progress of 82%. This is likely to be achieved by project completion. Base year: 2009
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Cross-border facilities rehabilitated Indicator: Cross-border facilities rehabilitated Progress/Status: The Government was unable to acquire the land. Data Source: Project accounts Project review missions Baseline year: 2009 Baseline year: 2009 Target year: 2013

Output: HIV prevention and anti-human trafficking program implemented Indicator: Reduced cases of HIV/AIDS by 10% from 2010 in 2013 Progress/Status: Several outreach programs and community events on the awareness of HIV/AIDs. Data Source: National Health Statistics Baseline year: 2009 Baseline year: 2009 Target year: 2013

Output: Project road rehabilitated Indicator: 113km of NR 56 rehabilitated in 2013, with 310 affected households resettled and compensated by 2013 Progress/Status: Civil works iof NR 56A completed in August 2014. Data Source: Monthly and quarterly project progress reports MPWT annual report Monitoring reports Baseline year: 2009 Baseline year: 2009 Target year: 2013

Output: Road maintenance program implemented Indicator: Reduced nationwide overloading violations by 40% from 2010 in 2013 Progress/Status: Maintenance of 9km section of NR6 from Siem Reap to Kralanh completed. Data Source: MPWT annual reports JICA Axle Load Control Program reports Baseline year: 2009 Baseline year: 2009 Target year: 2013

Output: Road safety program functioning efficiently Indicator: Reduced nationwide road accident fatalities by 20% from 2010 in 2013 Progress/Status: This component was split into consulting services and minor civil works. Data Source: National Health Statistics Baseline year: 2009 Baseline year: 2009 Target year: 2013
